```yaml
name: UI Core Components Tests

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - main
  pull_request:
    branches:
      - main

jobs:
  build-and-test:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
    - name: Checkout code
      uses: actions/checkout@v2

    - name: Set up Node.js
      uses: actions/setup-node@v2
      with:
        node-version: '16'

    - name: Install dependencies
      run: yarn install --frozen-lockfile

    - name: Upgrade Playwright
      run: yarn add @playwright/test@1.54.2

    - name: Update Playwright browsers
      run: npx playwright install --with-deps

    - name: Run tests
      run: yarn test
```

Please note that this workflow assumes you have a `yarn test` command set up in your project that runs your UI core components tests using Playwright. You may need to adjust the `run` commands based on your specific testing setup.
